_meta.purpose: The content-driven selection layer for a MODAL / DIALOG. A modal = a screen-filling Backdrop with a dialog surface (a Card, elevation 1) centered on top: a HEADER (title + optional description) + a BODY (a short message OR a few grouped fields) + a closing right-aligned ACTION row. Delivered via the runtime OVERLAY MODE (`overlay: true`). Each entry maps a CONTENT SHAPE (the kind of task) to a region or a body kind. To compose: identify the dialog KIND (confirm / acknowledge / input), fill the header, pick the matching body, then add the action row.
_meta.usage: Pick the body kind that matches the task. Prefer an existing block; author a new guideline-compliant one only when needed. Fill every placeholder with real content; never leave an empty Body/Input/Button. Keep the body short — a long form is a form/ screen, not a modal.
_meta.patternSource: Each `pattern` id resolves in modal/block-patterns.json; each block id in modal/blocks.json (fields are reused from form/blocks.json).

confirmation.intent: Ask the user to confirm or cancel a single action (often destructive): 'Möchten Sie … wirklich löschen?'.
confirmation.whenToUse: A yes/no decision that must block the screen until answered. Header (title + optional description) + a short message body (modal.body-text; a leading Notification semantic Critical, closeable:false, for a destructive/high-impact action) + a right-aligned two-button action row (secondary Abbrechen ghost FIRST + primary Brand RIGHTMOST, e.g. 'Endgültig löschen'). No danger button variant — Brand + severe wording carries it.

acknowledge.intent: Inform the user of something they must acknowledge before continuing (success, notice, error).
acknowledge.whenToUse: A one-way message with a single dismiss. Header + message body (modal.body-text) + a SINGLE Brand action ('OK' / 'Verstanden'), no secondary. A leading Notification (semantic Successful/Informational/Critical) may carry the status.

input.intent: Collect a small amount of input as an overlay (rename, invite a user, add a short entry).
input.whenToUse: A handful of grouped fields that resolve one task without leaving the screen. Header + a small fieldset body (modal.body-fields, fields reused from form/blocks.json) + a two-button action row (secondary Abbrechen + primary Brand submit). If it needs more than a small fieldset → it is a form/ screen, not a modal.

header.intent: Open the dialog: the title (Heading h2) + an optional one-line description.
header.whenToUse: Always, once, first. Title (h2, color.text.strong) + optional short description (Body, color.text.muted), grouped at sm (R−1). OPTIONAL/DEFERRED: a ghost icon-only 'cross' close button top-right (needs the 'cross' icon registered — until then the footer secondary dismisses).

actions.intent: Close the dialog with its primary action and an optional secondary.
actions.whenToUse: Always, once, last. A RIGHT-ALIGNED ContainerHorizontal (align 'right', gap sm): secondary (ghost/outlined) FIRST + primary (Brand) RIGHTMOST — dialog convention. ≤1 Brand per surface. An acknowledge dialog has a single Brand action, no secondary.

body-text.intent: The dialog message: 1–2 short Body paragraphs, optionally led by a Notification.
body-text.whenToUse: Confirmation / acknowledge dialogs. Body in color.text.strong (emphasis-100 — the message is primary copy, NOT muted); a leading Notification (semantic Critical/Warning/Successful/Informational, closeable:false — no X inside the dialog) for a destructive or status message. Keep it to a sentence or two.

body-fields.intent: The dialog's short input area: a few label-above, fillWidth fields.
body-fields.whenToUse: Input dialogs. A small stack of fields reused verbatim from form/blocks.json (form.text-field / form.select-field / form.field-row / form.radio-group / form.checkbox-group). Group them under an optional Body-bold question label; do NOT add a form h1/h2 (the dialog title carries it). If it grows past a small fieldset → form/ screen.
